awards_draft.label: NBA awards, All-NBA selections and draft
awards_draft.target: Award winner, All-NBA selections and draft position/outcomes

combo_props.label: NBA combo props (PRA, PR, PA, RA)
combo_props.target: Combined player points+rebounds+assists (or subset) over a strike

first_basket.label: NBA first basket scorer / first team to score
first_basket.target: Which player scores the first basket (or team scores first) of the game

game_moneyline_spread.label: NBA game winner and point-spread markets
game_moneyline_spread.target: Team wins outright or covers a stated spread over the full game (OT included per rules text)

game_overtime_and_team_events.label: NBA overtime, bench points and team-stat head-to-head
game_overtime_and_team_events.target: Game goes to overtime; team bench points over a strike; team A stat vs team B stat

game_total.label: NBA full-game total points
game_total.target: Combined points over a half-point strike (OT included per rules text)

game_win_margin.label: NBA winning-margin buckets
game_win_margin.target: Winning team and margin bucket (e.g. 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16+) at settlement including OT per rules

off_court_events.label: NBA off-court events: transactions, coaching, business, All-Star, schedule
off_court_events.target: A dated off-court event (trade, signing, coach change, announcement, All-Star participant) occurs by a stated date or condition

parlay_combo.label: NBA parlay / multi-leg combination markets
parlay_combo.target: Multiple game or player legs jointly resolving true (side, total, player prop legs)

player_assists.label: NBA player assists over/under ladder
player_assists.target: Player assists over an integer strike (2+ to 12+)

player_availability.label: NBA starting lineup / player availability
player_availability.target: Whether a player starts (or is in the starting lineup / is active)

player_escalator_payout.label: NBA scalar-payout escalator markets (points/threes)
player_escalator_payout.target: Expected payout of a single-game player stat under a convex payout schedule (e.g. points in 2-point bands, 0-10+ threes)

player_free_throws.label: NBA player free throws made
player_free_throws.target: Player free throws made over a strike

player_h2h_series_stats.label: Player head-to-head, series and Summer League player stats
player_h2h_series_stats.target: Player A vs player B stat comparison, series total/average, or Summer League player stat

player_milestones.label: NBA double-double / triple-double
player_milestones.target: Player records a double-double or triple-double

player_points.label: NBA player points over/under ladder
player_points.target: Player points over a half-point strike at 10+, 15+, 20+ etc., with DNP handling per rules text

player_rebounds.label: NBA player rebounds over/under ladder
player_rebounds.target: Player rebounds over a strike (typically 4+ to 14+)

player_threes.label: NBA player threes made over/under ladder
player_threes.target: Player three-pointers made over a strike (1+ to 7+)

quarter_and_half_markets.label: NBA quarter and half winner/spread/total/team total
quarter_and_half_markets.target: Quarter or half winner, margin, total or team total (OT excluded unless stated; ties possible)

race_to_and_points_leader.label: NBA race-to-N and game points leader
race_to_and_points_leader.target: Which team reaches N points first; which player scores the most points in the game

season_futures_team.label: NBA team season futures (title, conference, division, wins, playoffs, seed, round reach)
season_futures_team.target: Team's season win total, seed, playoff/play-in qualification, round reached, conference/division/title

season_stat_markets.label: NBA season stat leaders, streaks, records and specials
season_stat_markets.target: Season stat leader, player streaks, team records and special season outcomes

series_and_cup.label: NBA playoff series winner/props and NBA Cup
series_and_cup.target: Series winner, series length / sweep, and NBA Cup winner/stage outcomes

steals_blocks_turnovers.label: NBA steals, blocks, stocks and turnovers
steals_blocks_turnovers.target: Player steals / blocks / stocks / turnovers at 0.5, 1.5, 2.5 strikes

summer_league_games.label: NBA Summer League game and season markets
summer_league_games.target: Summer League winner, spread, total and tournament outcomes

team_total.label: NBA team total points
team_total.target: One named team's points over a half-point strike (OT included per rules text)

unreg:all_star_weekend_events.label: NBA All-Star Weekend events
unreg:all_star_weekend_events.target: Winner of an All-Star Weekend contest or exhibition game

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials.label: NBA player/team counting specials (triple doubles, stat averages, one-off thresholds)
unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials.target: A player or team reaching a single-game milestone or a season average threshold.

r20_003.rules_primary: If at least 9 freshmen are drafted in the top 10 of the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.
r20_003.rules_secondary: Note: This market refers specifically to players who are freshmen at U.S. colleges and universities during the 2025-26 academic year. International players who have not attended U.S. colleges do not qualify, regardless of their age or experience level.

r20_005.rules_primary: If Karim Lopez is drafted 1st between Karim Lopez and Hannes Steinbach in the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.

r20_006.rules_primary: If Meleek Thomas is drafted in the first 33 picks of the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.

r20_007.rules_primary: If Koa Peat is selected by Washington in the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.
r20_007.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the team that makes the actual selection at the time of the draft. Any post-draft trades or immediate draft-day trades following the selection do not affect the resolution of this market.

If Koa Peat does not get drafted, all markets will resolve to No.

r20_008.rules_primary: If Dailyn Swain is drafted top 10 in the 2026 Pro Basketball draft, then the market resolves to Yes.

r20_009.rules_primary: If Los Angeles C is awarded a top 5 pick in the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft Lottery, then the market resolves to Yes.
r20_009.rules_secondary: This market resolves to Yes based on the teams that are awarded the top 5 picks in the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft Lottery. It does not matter whether a team ultimately trades the pick or which teams make the top 5 selections at the time of the draft.

r20_010.rules_primary: If Washington wins the 2026 Pro Basketball Draft Lottery and is awarded the 1st overall pick, then the market resolves to Yes.
r20_010.rules_secondary: This market resolves to Yes based on the team that officially wins the Pro Basketball Draft Lottery and is awarded the No. 1 overall pick. It does not matter whether that team ultimately trades the pick or which team makes the first overall selection at the time of the draft.
